hooks.command: if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code session-start; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code session-end; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code pre-tool; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code post-tool-use; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code post-tool-use-failure; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code subagent-start; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code subagent-stop; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook claude-code post-compact; fi
